q: How do I book a consultation?
a: The quickest way is to tap Book Us Now and send us a message on WhatsApp. If you prefer email, you can send an enquiry from our Contact page and we will get back to you.

q: How much does an interior design project cost?
a: Every project is different, so we quote after an initial consultation once we understand the size of the space, the scope of work and the finishes you have in mind. You will always receive a clear quote before any work begins.

q: How long does a project take?
a: It depends on the scope. A single room or feature wall can be completed much faster than a full home. We agree a timeline with you at the start and keep you updated throughout.

q: Can you work with furniture I already own?
a: Absolutely. We are happy to design around pieces you love and combine them with new items, so the finished space feels personal and complete.

q: Do you handle installation, or just the design?
a: We take care of everything, from design and finishes through to installation, so you get a complete, finished result.

q: Can you do just one item, like a TV wall or headboard?
a: Yes. We are happy to take on a single piece, such as a TV wall unit, headboard or ceiling, as well as complete home makeovers. Send us a message to talk about what you have in mind.
